- Accepts typed capacities such as "},{"id":"p6s5","text":"`131072`, `256K`, or `1M`, and leaves a blank field inherited instead of copying the fallback into t"},{"id":"p6s6","text":"he model.
- Shows what a blank field would inherit from the provider's `defaultContextWindow`, `defa"},{"id":"p6s7","text":"ultMaxTokens`, and `defaultInput`.
- Preserves the model's other fields and existing provider-specif"},{"id":"p6s8","text":"ic wire values.
- Saves through DSH's settings service, so no manual configuration-file editing is n"},{"id":"p6s9","text":"e values.
